name: metabase
description: Read and write any Metabase instance through the official Metabase MCP server. List databases, tables, fields, questions, and dashboards; run saved questions; execute ad-hoc SQL or MBQL queries; create and update questions, dashboards, and cards; export results as CSV, JSON, or XLSX.

interface.shortDescription: Query and manage a Metabase instance through the official Metabase MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Your agent becomes your analytics assistant — querying your databases, running saved reports, building dashboards, and exporting data. Whether you need a quick sales number, want to check if a dashboard is up to date, or need a CSV export of your data, just ask. No more writing SQL by hand or digging through the Metabase interface for every answer.
defaultPrompt: Run this saved report and show me the results.
Export the data from this dashboard as a CSV.
Help me create a new question or chart from my data.
